label: WaterTAP Lead-Lag GAC Adsorption
request: Build and solve a two-bed WaterTAP GAC lead-lag train. Route contaminated water through a 6 m lead bed at 600 s EBCT and then a 6 m lag polishing bed at 600 s EBCT. Use native CPHSDM relationships, keep each captured-solute outlet separate, and report lead effluent, final solute, incremental lag removal, breakthrough-protection factor, overall removal, GAC inventory, and bed operational times.
